senses.gloss: , (b. h.) to prepare a feast, esp. to slaughter and dress meat, to cook.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 4a:5">Keth. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>טִבְחוֹ טָבוּחַ</he> his meat for the feast is ready (for cooking).—
<cite ref="Beitzah 25a:16">Bets. 25ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>בית טביחה</he>) <he>מקום שטוֹבַחַת וכ׳</he> the place where the animal cooks (digests) its food.
